capacity_basis: Derived, not published. The proponent has not stated a liquefaction capacity. This figure is constrained by the gas resource: Fermeuse Energy states the project would develop 9.7 trillion cubic feet of offshore associated gas in the Jeanne d'Arc Basin, which is 275 billion cubic metres. At 1.38 bcm per mtpa, spread over the 40-year operating life assumed elsewhere in this register, that supports 5.0 mtpa. Two other approaches give higher figures and were not used: the same reserve over a 25-year life gives 8.0 mtpa, and benchmarking the stated US$12 to 15 billion capital cost against Ksi Lisims and Cedar gives 9 to 12 mtpa. An unsourced third-party table circulates a figure of 10 mtpa. The lowest defensible derivation is used.
